description: This file defines the PostMetadata data structure and related types and methods for handling post-related metadata in the Mattermost project, including embeds, emojis, files, images, reactions, priorities, acknowledgements, and translations.

classes.name: PostMetadata
classes.description: Represents metadata associated with a post, including embeds, emojis, files, images, reactions, priority, acknowledgements, and translations.

classes.name: PostTranslation
classes.description: Represents a translation of a post in a specific language, including text or object, type, state, and source language.

classes.name: PostImage
classes.description: Contains image dimensions, format, and frame count for images associated with a post.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Generates a map of post metadata fields suitable for auditing purposes.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of PostMetadata instance.
